base_relationship.note: The startup tip adds only the six HQ214 F7 return artifacts. Production code is identical at the code-bearing base and the startup tip, so repairing at the commission tip repairs exactly the code-bearing state.

governing_contract_conformance.F7-RR-02: The accepted contract types governed_use_id as ExactRef and states a receipt is not general-purpose. Passing governed_use_id.object_id reduced that identity, so the repair restores the contract's own type.
governing_contract_conformance.F7-RR-01: The accepted contract defines comparability_requirements_ref as the exact requirement set that both anchors must jointly satisfy, with one result per surface. A ref that merely accompanied caller-asserted results did not name the consumed material.
governing_contract_conformance.F7-RR-03: The accepted contract requires the temporal identity contract to compose at minimum eight named surfaces and to preserve WAVE_LABEL != ORDINAL != CALENDAR_YEAR. A parsed ref plus a caller boolean constituted none of that.
governing_contract_conformance.F7-RR-04: The accepted contract makes SOURCE_EQUIVALENCE conditional on cross-universe and binds semantic equivalence in an exact scope. The already-resolved exact relation result is the authorized form; a bare token is not.

F7-RR-01.defect: comparability_requirements_ref was parsed and serialized but never bound to the requirement results actually consumed. Changing the ref while retaining the same caller result tuple did not change derivation.
F7-RR-01.repair: Request gains comparability_requirements_material. _bind_ref_to_material refuses unless the supplied material's canonical hash equals the ref's content_hash. The consumed surfaces are DERIVED from that bound material, and provenance declares the bound surfaces. A caller-supplied comparability_requirement_results tuple that disagrees with the bound material is refused.
F7-RR-01.no_new_ontology: The ref, the material and the surface vocabulary are the accepted contract's own names.

F7-RR-02.defect: Governed-use scope was reduced from the complete ExactRef to object_id, so two different exact governed-use refs sharing only an object_id both satisfied the same scope.
F7-RR-02.repair: New _scope_covers_governed_use replaces the string comparison for governed-use scope. A scope entry covers the governed use only when it names the full exact identity (kind + object_id + content_hash). A bare object_id token carries no content_hash and is therefore NOT evidence of exact scope; it is treated as no coverage. The EXPLICIT_UNRESTRICTED marker is retained as the only blanket grant. Both call sites now pass the whole ExactRef.
F7-RR-02.fail_closed_direction: The repair removes coverage rather than adding it, so it cannot be accused of widening the gate.
F7-RR-02.positive_path_preserved: The default fixture scope is EXPLICIT_UNRESTRICTED, so ordinary positive use is unaffected.

F7-RR-03.defect: The temporal identity contract ref was only parsed, and TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE resolution was independent of it, so an arbitrary exact identity ref plus a caller true boolean passed the identity gate.
F7-RR-03.repair: Request gains temporal_identity_contract_material, hash-bound to the identity ref by _bind_ref_to_material. identity_surface_jointly_satisfied is read from the AUTHORIZED material. A caller boolean that contradicts the material is refused rather than trusted.
F7-RR-03.no_caller_trusted_boolean: The boolean is now only a consistency cross-check against authorized material, never the source of the fact.

F7-RR-04.defect: source_equivalence_ref was accepted as a bare caller token whenever a scoped SOURCE_EQUIVALENCE authority snapshot existed, bypassing the already-resolved exact relation result the contract requires.
F7-RR-04.repair: Request gains source_relation_resolver. For a cross-universe pair the equivalence ref is resolved through the exact source-relation OWNER PATH (SourceRelationResolver.resolve_exact) and the resolved relation's own ref must equal the supplied ref. No resolver, an unresolvable ref, or a ref that disagrees with the resolved relation all yield the accepted refusal. The existing authority resolution and relation-authority-only validation are retained.
F7-RR-04.reason_code_discipline: The refusal reuses the ACCEPTED reason SOURCE_EQUIVALENCE_AUTHORITY_NOT_POSITIVE. An initial attempt introduced a new reason token that was in no state's precedence list and was therefore silently dropped, leaving the defect open; that is recorded because it is exactly the failure mode an invented code creates.
F7-RR-04.production_path_not_a_stub: The positive cross-universe court fixture builds a genuine SourceUniverseRelation through the accepted make_source_universe_relation factory and a real SourceRelationResolver. A stub resolver was rejected because it would relocate the caller-trust problem into the court.

shared_helper.name: _bind_ref_to_material
shared_helper.purpose: One place where a contract ref is proven to name the material it claims.
